info.title: Aplyd Academy R1 reference API
info.description: Draft implementation contracts derived from BRD and BASELINE.md, dated 2026-10-05. Provider-neutral modular monolith. Not a deployed service. OIDC login and OAuth tokens are obtained through selected managed identity adapter; authorization semantics are in LLD.md. All examples are synthetic. R2 endpoints require separate amendments.

identity_assertion.description: Short-lived assertion validated through approved identity adapter; never a password
Fresh proof of ownership of the other identity; issuer/subject collisions require manual resolution

contact.description: Contact address consumed by identity adapter; response never reveals whether an account exists

resource_access_path.description: Authorized same-origin resource access endpoint; not a public object URL

Attempt.description: Learner draft returned only to owner while draft; review_draft only to assigned assessor. Other authorized readers never receive these optional projections.

resource_key.description: Private asset reference validated against content ownership

PartnerEnrollment.description: learner_ref is an Academy-generated opaque membership reference. Resolve only within authenticated OAuth client tenant and current recipient/purpose/resource grant. It never contains raw issuer, subject or contact data.

PartnerAchievement.description: Fields beyond credential_reference are returned only when present in the current authorized grant allowlist. No learner profile, score, submission or other tenant affiliations.

ProcessEvidence.description: Generated draft may be empty when learner appropriately declines AI use; final judgment explains suitability. Sources are learner references; server does not fetch arbitrary URLs.

TenantId.name: tenant_id
TenantId.description: Workspace selected by caller; membership or OAuth-bound tenant is validated server-side.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required for retryable mutations. Scope is principal + tenant/platform scope + route. Canonical-body mismatch returns 409. Same request returns original committed response after fresh authorization.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Quoted ETag revision from resource response. Initial progress uses initial ETag "1" supplied with activity state; stale value returns 412.

Correlation.name: X-Correlation-ID
Correlation.description: Optional validated opaque request identifier; service returns its canonical correlation ID.
